attributes.name: [Elastic Cloud] Password spray
attributes.description: One client IP fails sign-in against at least 10 identities in 15 minutes.

investigation_guide.blob:
## Password spray

One client IP failed authentication against at least 10 identities, with at least 15 failures, in 15 minutes.

### Triage
1. Review the identities targeted from this IP on **[Audit] Identity & Access**.
2. A single shared NAT can look similar. Compare with the source IP's usual identities.

### Tuning
Raise the identity or failure threshold for networks that share one egress address.

esqlQuery.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-*
| WHERE event.action == "authentication_failed"
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name)
| WHERE actor IS NOT NULL
| EVAL actor_kind = CASE(user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", "cloud_api_key", user.email IS NOT NULL, "user", api_key.name IS NOT NULL OR authentication.type == "api_key", "api_key", "principal")
| WHERE actor NOT IN ("elastic.maintenance", "autoscaling", "elasticsearch-controller", "elastic/fleet-server", "elastic/kibana")
| WHERE client.ip IS NOT NULL
| STATS identities = COUNT_DISTINCT(CONCAT(actor_kind, ":", actor)), failures = COUNT(*) BY client.ip
| WHERE identities >= 10 AND failures >= 15
| SORT failures DESC
| LIMIT 100
